- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast by 1–3% for consecutive high sentiment days.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (e.g., >78.5) — add 2–5% buffer to forecast if sentiment dips below 0.3.
- Lagged overreaction: if model peaks 2–3 days after sentiment peak, reduce forecast by 1–2% to avoid overcorrection.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above 30-day moving average, adjust downward by 1–3% if sentiment is neutral or declining.
- Horizon-specific: for 30-day forecasts, reduce final 5–7 days if sentiment is weak (≤0.3) — avoid over-optimism in low sentiment periods.
- Overshoot correction: if forecast exceeds true outcome by >5% for 3 consecutive days, apply a 2–4% downward adjustment to next forecast.
